#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <math.h>


#define MAX_DEGREE 1000

int create_array(int n, double **a)
{
    *a = malloc((n + 1) * sizeof **a);
    return *a == NULL ? EXIT_FAILURE : EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

int fill_array(double a[], int n)
{
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        printf("a[%d] = ", i);
        if (scanf("%lf", &a[i]) != 1 || !isfinite(a[i])) {
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
    }
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

void print_array(const double a[], int n)
{
    printf("Coefficients a[0..%d]:", n);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        printf(" %.12g", a[i]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
}

void horner_iter(const double a[], int n,
                 double x, double *result)
{
    *result = a[n];
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        *result = *result * x + a[i];
    }
}

void horner_rec(const double a[], int n, int i,
                double x, double *result)
{
    if (i == n) {
        *result = a[n];
    } else {
        horner_rec(a, n, i + 1, x, result);
        *result = *result * x + a[i];
    }
}

int main(void)
{
    int n;
    double *a;
    double x, iterative, recursive;

    printf("Degree (0..%d): ", MAX_DEGREE);
    if (scanf("%9d", &n) != 1 || n < 0 || n > MAX_DEGREE) {
        puts("Invalid degree.");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (create_array(n, &a) != EXIT_SUCCESS) {
        puts("Memory allocation failed.");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (fill_array(a, n) != EXIT_SUCCESS) {
        puts("Invalid coefficient.");
        free(a);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    printf("x = ");
    if (scanf("%lf", &x) != 1 || !isfinite(x)) {
        puts("Invalid x.");
        free(a);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    print_array(a, n);
    horner_iter(a, n, x, &iterative);
    horner_rec(a, n, 0, x, &recursive);
    free(a);

    if (!isfinite(iterative) || !isfinite(recursive)) {
        puts("Result is outside the finite double range.");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    printf("Iterative p(x) = %.12g\n", iterative);
    printf("Recursive p(x) = %.12g\n", recursive);
    if (iterative != recursive) {
        puts("Equivalence: FAIL");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    puts("Equivalence: OK");
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
